}}'''Ivonell Bharatiya''' was a scholar from before the [[Trolloc Wars]].{{ref|{{twotc}}, Ivonell Bharatiya}}
==History==
She wrote of "hounds born of the Shadow, in numbers like unto the nightmares of mankind." [[Masuri]] cites this as she tells [[Perrin]] and the others of the [[Darkhounds]] outside his camp, but she doubts the source as well as the existence of Ivonell herself.
